class Base {
  protected value = 2;
}
class Derived extends Base {
  field: number;
  optional?: number;
  asserted!: number;
  constructor() {
    super();
    ({ value: this.field } = { value: 3 });
    this.field++;
    console.log(this.field, this.optional, this.asserted, this.value);
  }
  read(other: Derived) {
    const { nested: { ["value"]: value } } = { nested: other };
    return value;
  }
}
const instance = new Derived();
console.log(instance.read(instance));

class Names {
  "static title" = "instance";
  static title = "class";
  ["static show"]() { return 1; }
  static show() { return 2; }
}
console.log(new Names()["static title"], Names.title, new Names()["static show"](), Names.show());

function mix<T extends new (...args: any[]) => object>(Base: T) {
  return class extends Base {
    protected rank = 1;
    protected method() { return 2; }
  };
}
class A {}
class C extends mix(A) {
  read(value = this.rank) { return value + this.method(); }
}
console.log(new C().read());

class Defaults {
  constructor(public amount = this.forward) {}
  forward = 1;
  read(value: number = this.later()) { return value; }
  later() { return this.forward; }
  static field = 2;
  static read(value = Defaults.field) { return value; }
}
console.log(new Defaults().read(), Defaults.read(), new Defaults().amount);

const annotated = { x: 1, read(this: {x: number}, value = this.x) { return value; } };
console.log(annotated.read());

class RecursiveDefaults {
  constant(value = this.constant()) { return 1; }
  annotated(value = this.annotated()): number { return value; }
}
console.log(new RecursiveDefaults().constant(4), new RecursiveDefaults().annotated(5));
